messages.content: How do I check disk usage in Linux?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a concise Linux command for disk usage.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Use `df -h` for filesystem usage and `du -sh <dir>` for directory size.</content>
</action>
